tokens.name: brand-space
tokens.usage: Deep-space ground of the logo artwork (sampled). The only background the logo image may sit on; the dark theme's page ground.

tokens.name: brand-haze
tokens.usage: Nebula haze behind the mark (sampled). Large decorative fields and the cover; never behind body text in light theme.

tokens.name: brand-cyan
tokens.usage: Orbit cyan, the cool edge of the P and ring (sampled). Identity colour: cover blocks, glows, illustrations. For text or controls use `accent`.

tokens.name: brand-glow
tokens.usage: Cyan highlight where the ring catches light (sampled). Glows and highlights on brand-space only.

tokens.name: brand-periwinkle
tokens.usage: Periwinkle mid-tone where cyan turns to magenta (sampled). Secondary illustration fills.

tokens.name: brand-magenta
tokens.usage: Nebula magenta, the warm edge of the ring (sampled). Identity colour: cover, highlights. For text use `accent-2`.

tokens.name: brand-violet
tokens.usage: Wordmark violet (sampled from PUJIVERSE letters). Display type on light grounds, deep fills.

tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Page ground (dark = brand-space).

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Panels: the visual stage and the navigator.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles and inputs on surface-100.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Hover and selected rows; chip fills.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card and panel edges, dividers (decorative, not meaning-bearing).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and chip outlines; meets 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-000 to surface-300.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: categories, counts, notes, on surface-000 to surface-300.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, primary button fill, selected state, active breadcrumb. As text on any surface.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-2
tokens.usage: Secondary highlight (hover twin, compare tray count). As text on any surface.

tokens.name: on-accent-2
tokens.usage: Label on an accent-2 fill.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element.

tokens.name: domain-land
tokens.usage: Land domain accent (amber): tints tiles, headers and breadcrumbs in that domain; as text on any surface.

tokens.name: domain-land-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind domain-land text and illustrations.

tokens.name: domain-rail
tokens.usage: Rail domain accent (teal): tints tiles, headers and breadcrumbs in that domain; as text on any surface.

tokens.name: domain-rail-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind domain-rail text and illustrations.

tokens.name: domain-water
tokens.usage: Water domain accent (blue): tints tiles, headers and breadcrumbs in that domain; as text on any surface.

tokens.name: domain-water-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind domain-water text and illustrations.

tokens.name: domain-air
tokens.usage: Air domain accent (sky/cyan): tints tiles, headers and breadcrumbs in that domain; as text on any surface.

tokens.name: domain-air-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind domain-air text and illustrations.

tokens.name: domain-space
tokens.usage: Space domain accent (violet): tints tiles, headers and breadcrumbs in that domain; as text on any surface.

tokens.name: domain-space-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind domain-space text and illustrations.

tokens.name: status-positive
tokens.usage: In production; Widely available; High confidence. As text on its -soft fill or any surface; always paired with a word.

tokens.name: status-positive-soft
tokens.usage: Pill fill behind status-positive text.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: In service / Operational. As text on its -soft fill or any surface; always paired with a word.

tokens.name: status-info-soft
tokens.usage: Pill fill behind status-info text.

tokens.name: status-neutral
tokens.usage: Discontinued, Retired, Historical, Completed mission. As text on its -soft fill or any surface; always paired with a word.

tokens.name: status-neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Pill fill behind status-neutral text.

tokens.name: status-caution
tokens.usage: In development; Limited / select countries; Medium confidence. As text on its -soft fill or any surface; always paired with a word.

tokens.name: status-caution-soft
tokens.usage: Pill fill behind status-caution text.

tokens.name: status-negative
tokens.usage: Not available; Low confidence. As text on its -soft fill or any surface; always paired with a word.

tokens.name: status-negative-soft
tokens.usage: Pill fill behind status-negative text.

tokens.name: avail-wide
tokens.usage: Availability grid cell (wide); alias of status-positive. Always with its label.

tokens.name: avail-limited
tokens.usage: Availability grid cell (limited); alias of status-caution. Always with its label.

tokens.name: avail-none
tokens.usage: Availability grid cell (none); alias of status-negative. Always with its label.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Site title and hero only, uppercase.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Domain headers and Level 4 product name, uppercase.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Price block figures; use tabular numerals.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, pill inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gaps, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding, list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; mobile side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding, grid gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section spacing inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between major groups (domain sections).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero and cover spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, availability cells.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, panels, compare tray (spec: 14px).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, status pills, badges, year chips, monogram discs.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Card hover lift (with translateY(-2px)).

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Selected tile / hovered twin: the orbit glow.

tokens.name: shadow-tray
tokens.usage: Docked compare tray.
